quotes.text: May I just check, is the main reason because you were... 1 ...looking after children? 2 looking after an incapacitated adult? 3 or some other reason?

May I just check, was the main reason that you did not look for work because... 1 Were you caring for children below school age, 2 Were you caring for other children,, 3 Were you caring for a dependent adult relative, 4 or some other reason?

assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument does not ask about responsibility for, performance of, or magnitude of unpaid domestic and care work. Questions mentioning care or domestic commitments, such as YPTCIA and NOLWF, only ask about reasons for working part-time or reasons for not looking for work. The indicator definition explicitly excludes categories of inactivity, activity status classifications, or reasons for not working from counting toward responsibility or performance. Furthermore, no question in the survey records the duration or frequency of unpaid domestic or care work.
